summary: SPEC-08 R1 and R7. An experiment window only says which strategy was planned; nothing recorded whether, when or how that strategy was actually put on the ship. Battles inside a window were therefore credited to a strategy that might not yet have been in force.  Add StrategyAdoption (alias, strategy key and config_version, UTC adopted_at, method bot-call or by-hand, optional note refused when secret-shaped) and AdoptionLog, a per-alias strictly time-ordered log that refuses out-of-order or same-instant entries and loads from / saves to a local JSON file. TrialRecord joins the schedule and the log: strategy_in_force(alias, at) returns a strategy only when the latest adoption at or before `at` is of the window's strategy version and was made inside that window. By-hand adoptions mark the attribution's timing as approximate so reports can say so (R7).  Names avoid "apply" to keep sdk/pvp's no-mutation identifier rule. Implemented by the SPEC-08 builder specialist subagent in an isolated worktree, independently reviewed by the verifier subagent (tests cite its requirement ids; parent re-validated in a scratch clone), and re-validated by the parent.
